about: Roads that close for the season or need winter care. open/close are the usual first and last days the road is open (MM-DD); real dates move with the snow, so dates within two weeks of them count as uncertain. kind: closed (closes for the season), caution (open, but winter rules or conditions in the listed months), check (closures happen at any time). at: points ON the road; a day whose route passes within radius_km of one crosses it. match: words in a road's name. Checked against park and road authority pages in 2026; always confirm before you go.

roads.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road
roads.note: The alpine section over Logan Pass usually opens in late June or early July and closes in mid October. Summer vehicle reservations may apply.

roads.name: Tioga Road (CA 120, Yosemite)
roads.note: Closed from the first big snow (usually November) until late May or June.

roads.name: Glacier Point Road (Yosemite)
roads.note: Closed past Badger Pass from November to late May or June.

roads.name: Trail Ridge Road (US 34, Rocky Mountain NP)
roads.note: Usually open Memorial Day to mid October. Timed entry permits are needed in summer.

roads.name: Beartooth Highway (US 212)
roads.note: Usually open Memorial Day weekend to mid October; snowstorms can close it any month.

roads.name: Mount Blue Sky Road (CO 5)
roads.note: The road to the summit is usually open Memorial Day to Labor Day, with timed entry reservations.

roads.name: Independence Pass (CO 82)
roads.note: Closed from early November to Memorial Day weekend. Vehicles over 35 feet are not allowed.

roads.name: Cottonwood Pass (CO 306)
roads.note: Closed in winter, usually November to late May.

roads.name: Kebler Pass (CO 12)
roads.note: Gravel road, closed to cars in winter.

roads.name: Million Dollar Highway (US 550)
roads.note: Open all year, but snow, ice and avalanche closures are common from November to April, and there are no guardrails on long stretches.

roads.name: Mount Washington Auto Road
roads.note: Private toll road, usually open mid May to late October, weather permitting.

roads.name: Whiteface Veterans Memorial Highway
roads.note: Toll road to the summit, usually open late May to mid October.

roads.name: Smugglers' Notch (VT 108)
roads.note: The road through the notch is closed in winter, usually November to mid May. No trucks or trailers.

roads.name: Sonora Pass (CA 108)
roads.note: Closed from the first heavy snow to late May.

roads.name: Ebbetts Pass (CA 4)
roads.note: Closed from the first heavy snow to late May. Narrow and steep, not for trailers.

roads.name: Monitor Pass (CA 89)
roads.note: Closed in winter storms and usually all winter.

roads.name: Emerald Bay (CA 89, Lake Tahoe)
roads.note: Closes for days at a time after big snowstorms (avalanche risk).

roads.name: Lassen Volcanic National Park Highway (CA 89)
roads.note: The road through the park usually opens in June or July once the snow is cleared, and closes in the fall.

roads.name: Kings Canyon Scenic Byway to Cedar Grove (CA 180)
roads.note: Closed past Hume Lake from mid November to late April.

roads.name: Big Sur coast (CA 1)
roads.note: Landslides close parts of Highway 1 through Big Sur from time to time. Check Caltrans QuickMap before you go.

roads.name: Crater Lake Rim Drive
roads.note: The full Rim Drive is usually open July to October. Rim Village stays open in winter.

roads.name: McKenzie Pass (OR 242)
roads.note: Closed from November to late June. No vehicles over 35 feet.

roads.name: Steens Mountain Loop Road
roads.note: Gravel road, the upper gates usually open in July and close in the fall.

roads.name: North Cascades Highway (WA 20)
roads.note: Closed between Ross Lake and Mazama from about mid November to late April or May.

roads.name: Chinook Pass (WA 410)
roads.note: Closed in winter, usually from November to late May.

roads.name: Sunrise Road (Mount Rainier)
roads.note: Usually open July to late September.

roads.name: Stevens Canyon Road (Mount Rainier)
roads.note: Closed in winter, usually November to late May.

roads.name: Yellowstone park roads
roads.note: Most park roads close to cars from early November to mid or late April. Only the north road (Gardiner to Cooke City) stays open.

roads.name: Dunraven Pass (Yellowstone)
roads.note: The road between Tower and Canyon opens later than the rest of the park, usually late May.

roads.name: Teton Park Road
roads.note: Closed to cars from November 1 to April 30 (open to skiers and walkers). US 89 stays open.

roads.name: Snowy Range Road (WY 130)
roads.note: Closed over the pass from about mid November to Memorial Day.

roads.name: Grand Canyon North Rim (AZ 67)
roads.note: AZ 67 to the North Rim is closed in winter (usually December to mid May) and services close in mid October. The 2025 Dragon Bravo Fire burned the lodge, so check the park's current status.

roads.name: Cedar Breaks (UT 148)
roads.note: UT 148 through the monument is closed in winter, usually November to late May.

roads.name: Mirror Lake Highway (UT 150)
roads.note: Closed past Soapstone in winter, usually November to late May or June.

roads.name: Alpine Loop (UT 92)
roads.note: Closed in winter, usually November to late May. Narrow, no trailers over 30 feet.

roads.name: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive (Great Basin)
roads.note: The upper road is open about June to October.

roads.name: Blue Ridge Parkway
roads.note: Sections close in winter for snow and ice. Check the parkway's road status map.

roads.name: Skyline Drive
roads.note: Closes during and after snow and ice storms.

roads.name: Highwood Pass (AB 40)
roads.note: Closed every year from December 1 to June 14 to protect wildlife.

roads.name: Moraine Lake Road
roads.note: Open about June to mid October, and only for Parks Canada shuttles and buses: personal cars aren't allowed.

roads.name: Icefields Parkway (AB 93)
roads.note: Open all year, but winter tires or chains are required from November 1 to April 1, and there's no fuel or cell signal for 230 km.

roads.name: Rogers Pass (Trans-Canada, BC 1)
roads.note: Avalanche control closes the highway for hours at a time in winter. BC requires winter tires from October 1 to April 30.

roads.name: BC mountain highways (Sea-to-Sky, Duffey Lake, Coquihalla, Kootenay)
roads.note: BC requires winter tires or chains on most highways from October 1 to April 30.

roads.name: Great Alpine Road (Mount Hotham)
roads.note: During the snow season (about June to early October) you must carry snow chains between Harrietville and Omeo, and pay resort entry at Mount Hotham.

roads.name: Alpine Way and Kosciuszko Road
roads.where: Dead Horse Gap, New South Wales
roads.note: In Kosciuszko National Park, 2WD vehicles must carry snow chains from the June long weekend to the October long weekend.

roads.name: Snowy Mountains Highway (Kiandra)
roads.note: Snow and black ice on the high plains near Kiandra in winter. Carry chains.

roads.name: Milford Road (SH 94)
roads.note: Avalanche season: you must carry snow chains from May 1 to November 30, stopping is banned in avalanche zones, and the road can close at short notice.

roads.name: Crown Range Road
roads.note: Snow and ice in winter; carry chains. Caravans and trailers are banned.

roads.name: Southern Alps passes (Arthur's, Lewis, Lindis, Haast)
roads.note: Snow, ice and slips can close these passes in winter. Carry chains and check the NZTA map.

roads.name: Desert Road (SH 1)
roads.note: Often closed by snow in winter, sometimes for a day or more.

roads.name: Bealach na Bà
roads.note: Often impassable in snow and ice, and not suitable for caravans or learner drivers at any time.

roads.name: Hardknott and Wrynose Passes
roads.note: 30% grades that ice over in winter; avoid in snow.

roads.name: Snow Roads (Cairnwell and the Lecht)
roads.note: Britain's highest roads, regularly closed by snow in winter (the snow gates shut).

roads.name: Stelvio Pass
roads.note: Closed in winter; usually open from late May or early June to early November.

roads.name: Gavia Pass
roads.note: Usually open mid June to mid October; narrow, often with snow walls early in the season.

roads.name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
roads.note: Toll road, usually open from early May to late October or early November; closed at night.

roads.name: Timmelsjoch
roads.note: Toll road, usually open June to mid October, daytime only (about 7 am to 8 pm).

roads.name: Silvretta High Alpine Road
roads.note: Toll road, usually open June to October.

roads.name: Swiss high passes (Furka, Grimsel, Susten, Gotthard, Nufenen, Klausen)
roads.note: Closed in winter; most open in June and close in October or at the first big snow. The Gotthard road tunnel stays open all year.

roads.name: Great St Bernard and San Bernardino Passes
roads.note: The pass roads close in winter; the tunnels below them stay open all year.

roads.name: Col de l'Iseran and Col du Galibier
roads.note: Closed in winter; usually open late June to early October (the Galibier a little longer).

roads.name: Col de la Bonette
roads.note: Usually open mid June to mid October.

roads.name: Year-round Alpine passes (Bernina, Julier, the Dolomites)
roads.note: Kept open in winter but snow tyres or chains are required, and storms close them for hours.
